get.description: Upgrades to a WebSocket that streams best-effort change signals for this mailbox: message.new (delivery), message.updated / message.expunged / message.restored / message.purged, label.expunged (IMAP EXPUNGE), label.created / label.renamed / label.deleted, and trash.emptied. Each frame is `{ v, type, ts, data }` with identifiers only — never message content. Signals are not a journal: there is no replay or backlog, so on every (re)connect re-sync via the list endpoints and treat each event as 'this changed, re-fetch it'. A `ready` frame with the session deadline is sent on connect; the session is closed with code 4401 (session_expired — reconnect with a fresh bearer) after 12h or 4410 (mailbox_gone — stop reconnecting). Keepalive: send a `ping` text frame, receive `pong`.
